self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Astral Whispers Beyond the Sacred Throne (R5): ATK is increased by 56% for 8s after the equipping character's attacks hit an opponent while the equipping character is off-field.

en.flavor: An ancient ceremonial weapon passed down by the Masters of the Night-Wind. This dark bow is forever wreathed in an unshakable chill.

passive.name: Astral Whispers Beyond the Sacred Throne

fr.flavor: Une arme cérémonielle ancestrale transmise par les Maîtres du vent nocturne. Cet arc ténébreux est à jamais imprégné d'un froid inébranlable.

passive.name: Murmures astraux d'au-delà du trône sacré
